teaching.title: Programming Tutor
bullets: Discussed debugging approaches during tutoring sessions covering loops, variables, and conditionals in programming.
Asked learners to explain the steps in their solutions involving loops, variables, and conditionals.

teaching.title: Teaching Assistant
bullets: Helped organise assignment materials and submission records for assignments on functions and debugging.
